**1.67h**

I finished the pcb today (excluding silkscreen, I don't really have ideas rn so I'm going to think about it). I added a switch and moved the microcontroller up so the usb cable can actually be on the edge.
I also started the 3d casing for it. I also ran out of ideas (just really tired today), so I'll think about designs. I added a groove into the bottom part of the case so the pcb, after accounting for tolerances, can "snap" into place and not fall out (with 1 mm thick jut outs on the bottom and top). I need to figure out how to get the usb shaped hole correct and easy to access.
I'm quite nervous as to whether I can get the hours in this week. I'm super tired these days + college apps due + weekend is super busy. Hopefully.
